tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Source palette. Ink in light, ground in dark.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Source palette. The accent: Submit.

tokens.name: brand-red
tokens.usage: Source palette. Failure and time up; text uses the darker fail token in light.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: Source palette. Last 5 minutes and limit verdicts.

tokens.name: brand-grey
tokens.usage: Source palette. Panels in light, ink in dark.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and editor background. Ground for fg, fg-2, fg-3, link, pass, fail, warn.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: file tree, results, stdin, problem code blocks. Same text tokens as bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, inline code, meter track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes and table rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls: outline buttons, inputs, selects, pills (3:1 on bg and surface).

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg and surface.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body copy in the problem pane, descriptions.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Captions, uppercase labels, placeholders, line numbers (4.5:1 on bg and surface).

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Solid buttons (Start interview, Export) and toasts.

tokens.name: inverse-fg
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-bg.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Submit only. One accent element per screen. Also the editor cursor.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Submit on hover: darker in light, lighter in dark, so on-accent reads better on hover than at rest.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent: the page background, cut out of the blue. Light: 3.8:1 at rest, under 4.5:1 for small text (owner's choice), 4.6:1 on accent-hover. Dark: 4.8:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in rendered problem markdown.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Accepted, passing counts, full meters, done part chips. Always with a word or a check mark.

tokens.name: pass-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind pass badges and done chips.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Wrong Answer, Compile Error, Runtime Error, failing lines, End, time up.

tokens.name: fail-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind fail badges and the End confirmation.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Time Limit Exceeded, Memory Limit Exceeded, did not finish, after-time events.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn badges and the health banner.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Disabled or not-yet-run states.

tokens.name: timer-low-fg
tokens.usage: Clock text in its last 5 minutes.

tokens.name: timer-low-bg
tokens.usage: Clock highlight in its last 5 minutes: the yellow block.
